name: WalkScore
description: Fetches Walk Score ratings from the Walk Score API for geolocation fields and displays them via a field formatter.
project_description:
Provides the Walk Score for node locations.

 Allows users to:

 
 Integrate Walk Score into your site 
 Add Walk Scores to nodes 
 Display the Walk Score Block on each node 
 
 The Walk Score API is supported in the United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 This module requires the following modules:

 
 Location 
 
 This module also requires a Walk Score API Key. An API key can be obtained at http://www.walkscore.com/professional/api-sign-up.php 

 INSTALLATION 
 
 composer require drupal/walkscore
